ai-security-pqc.title: AI Security & PQC

api-security-jwt.title: API Security & JWT

aerospace-pqc.title: Aerospace PQC

arch-quantum-impact.title: Architect Quantum Impact
arch-quantum-impact.description: Architecture decisions that outlast the quantum transition: KMS, HSM, PKI, hybrid deployment patterns, and crypto-agile design.

automotive-pqc.title: Automotive PQC

code-signing.title: Code Signing

compliance-strategy.title: Compliance & Regulatory Strategy
compliance-strategy.description: Map multi-jurisdiction requirements, build audit checklists, and construct compliance timelines from live framework data.

confidential-computing.title: Confidential Computing & TEEs

crypto-agility.title: Crypto Agility
crypto-agility.description: Design crypto-agile architectures: abstraction layers, CBOM scanning, and the 7-phase migration framework.

crypto-dev-apis.title: Cryptographic APIs & Developer Languages
crypto-dev-apis.description: Compare JCA/JCE, OpenSSL EVP, PKCS#11, Windows CNG, and Bouncy Castle across 7 languages. Provider patterns, PQC library selection, support matrix, crypto agility patterns, and migration decision lab.

crypto-mgmt-modernization.title: Cryptographic Management Modernization
crypto-mgmt-modernization.description: Build a modern cryptographic posture management program across certificates, libraries, software, and keys — iterative and ROI-positive even if quantum never arrives.

data-asset-sensitivity.description: Classify organizational data assets, map compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2), apply NIST RMF/ISO 27005/FAIR risk methodologies, and generate a PQC migration priority map.

database-encryption-pqc.title: Database Encryption & PQC

dev-quantum-impact.title: Developer Quantum Impact

email-signing.title: Email & Document Signing

energy-utilities-pqc.description: PQC migration for power grids and utilities: NERC CIP compliance, IEC 61850/62351 substation security, DNP3/Modbus protocol hardening, smart meter key management at scale, and environmental/safety risk scoring.

exec-quantum-impact.title: Executive Quantum Impact
exec-quantum-impact.description: Why quantum matters to leadership: fiduciary risk, regulatory deadlines (CNSA 2.0, NIS2, DORA), and building a board-level PQC action plan.

5g-security.title: 5G Security
5g-security.description: Explore 3GPP security architecture: SUCI Deconcealment, 5G-AKA, & Provisioning.

healthcare-pqc.title: Healthcare PQC
healthcare-pqc.description: Healthcare-specific PQC challenges: biometric data permanence, pharmaceutical IP protection, patient privacy lifecycles, medical device safety, and hospital network migration.

hsm-pqc.title: HSM & PQC Operations
hsm-pqc.description: Hardware Security Module operations for PQC: PKCS#11 v3.2, vendor comparison, firmware migration, and FIPS 140-3 validation.

hybrid-crypto.title: Hybrid Cryptography
hybrid-crypto.description: Combine classical and PQC algorithms: hybrid KEMs, composite signatures, and side-by-side certificate comparison.

iot-ot-pqc.title: IoT & OT Security
iot-ot-pqc.description: PQC challenges for constrained devices: algorithm selection for limited memory/compute, firmware signing, CoAP/DTLS protocol impacts, certificate chain bloat, and SCADA/ICS migration.

kms-pqc.title: KMS & PQC Key Management
kms-pqc.description: PQC key management patterns: envelope encryption with ML-KEM, hybrid key wrapping, multi-provider rotation planning.

mls-group-messaging.title: MLS — Group Messaging

os-pqc.title: Operating System & Platform Crypto PQC

ops-quantum-impact.title: Ops Quantum Impact

pqc-grc.title: PQC GRC
pqc-grc.description: Wire post-quantum risk into governance, risk, and compliance: cascade Key Risk Indicators from board to operational level, triage a deferral exception register into SOC suppression, and hand off cleanly between GRC and the SOC.

qkd.description: Explore QKD fundamentals: BB84 protocol, classical post-processing, hybrid key derivation, global deployments, protocol integration, and HSM key derivation.

stateful-signatures.description: Master LMS/HSS and XMSS/XMSS^MT: Merkle tree signatures, parameter trade-offs, and critical state management.

tls-basics.description: Deep dive into TLS 1.3 handshakes, certificates, and cipher suites.
